15#[derive(Error, Debug)]
16pub enum DecryptionError {
17    #[error("the /Encrypt dictionary is missing")]
18    MissingEncryptDictionary,
19    #[error("missing encryption version")]
20    MissingVersion,
21    #[error("missing encryption revision")]
22    MissingRevision,
23    #[error("missing the owner password (/O)")]
24    MissingOwnerPassword,
25    #[error("missing the user password (/U)")]
26    MissingUserPassword,
27    #[error("missing the permissions field (/P)")]
28    MissingPermissions,
29    #[error("missing the file /ID elements")]
30    MissingFileID,
31
32    #[error("invalid hash length")]
33    InvalidHashLength,
34    #[error("invalid key length")]
35    InvalidKeyLength,
36    #[error("invalid ciphertext length")]
37    InvalidCipherTextLength,
38    #[error("invalid permission length")]
39    InvalidPermissionLength,
40    #[error("invalid version")]
41    InvalidVersion,
42    #[error("invalid revision")]
43    InvalidRevision,
44    // Used generically when the object type violates the spec
45    #[error("unexpected type; document does not comply with the spec")]
46    InvalidType,
47
48    #[error("the object is not capable of being decrypted")]
49    NotDecryptable,
50    #[error("the supplied password is incorrect")]
51    IncorrectPassword,
52
53    #[error("the document uses an encryption scheme that is not implemented in lopdf")]
54    UnsupportedEncryption,
55    #[error("the encryption version is not implemented in lopdf")]
56    UnsupportedVersion,
57    #[error("the encryption revision is not implemented in lopdf")]
58    UnsupportedRevision,
59
60    #[error(transparent)]
61    StringPrep(#[from] stringprep::Error),
62    #[error("invalid padding encountered when decrypting, key might be incorrect")]
63    Padding,
64}

66bitflags! {
67    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
68    pub struct Permissions: u64 {
69        /// (Security handlers of revision 2) Print the document.
70        /// (Security handlers of revision 3 or greater) Print the document (possibly not at the
71        /// highest quality level, depending on whether [`Permissions::PRINTABLE_IN_HIGH_QUALITY`]
72        /// is also set).
73        const PRINTABLE = 1 << 2;
74
75        /// Modify the contents of the document by operations other than those controlled by
76        /// [`Permissions::ANNOTABLE`], [`Permissions::FILLABLE`] and [`Permissions::ASSEMBLABLE`].
77        const MODIFIABLE = 1 << 3;
78
79        /// Copy or otherwise extract text and graphics from the document. However, for the limited
80        /// purpose of providing this content to assistive technology, a PDF reader should behave
81        /// as if this bit was set to 1.
82        const COPYABLE = 1 << 4;
83
84        /// Add or modify text annotations, fill in interactive form fields, and if
85        /// [`Permissions::MODIFIABLE`] is also set, create or modify interactive form fields
86        /// (including signature fields).
87        const ANNOTABLE = 1 << 5;
88
89        /// Fill in existing interactive fields (including signature fields), even if
90        /// [`Permissions::ANNOTABLE`] is clear.
91        const FILLABLE = 1 << 8;
92
93        /// Copy or otherwise extract text and graphics from the document for the purpose of
94        /// providing this content to assistive technology.
95        ///
96        /// Deprecated since PDF 2.0: must always be set for backward compatibility with PDF
97        /// viewers following earlier specifications.
98        const COPYABLE_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY = 1 << 9;
99
100        /// (Security handlers of revision 3 or greater) Assemble the document (insert, rotate, or
101        /// delete pages and create document outline items or thumbnail images), even if
102        /// [`Permissions::MODIFIABLE`] is not set.
103        const ASSEMBLABLE = 1 << 10;
104
105        /// (Security handlers of revision 3 or greater) Print the document to a representation
106        /// from which a faithful copy of the PDF content could be generated, based on an
107        /// implementation-dependent algorithm. When this bit is clear (and
108        /// [`Permissions::PRINTABLE`] is set), printing shall be limited to a low-level
109        /// representation of the appearance, possibly of degraded quality.
110        const PRINTABLE_IN_HIGH_QUALITY = 1 << 11;
111    }
112}
113
114impl Default for Permissions {
115    fn default() -> Self {
116        Self::all()
117    }
118}

120impl Permissions {
121    fn correct_bits(self) -> Self {
122        let mut bits = self.bits();
123
124        // 7-8: Reserved. Must be 1.
125        bits |= 0b11 << 6;
126
127        // 13-32: Reserved. Must be 1.
128        bits |= 0b1111 << 12 | 0xffff << 16;
129
130        // Extend the permissions (contents of the P integer) to 64 bits by setting the upper 32
131        // bits to all 1s.
132        bits |= 0xffffffff << 32;
133
134        Permissions::from_bits_retain(bits)
135    }
136}

138#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
139pub enum EncryptionVersion<'a> {
140    /// (PDF 1.4; deprecated in PDF 2.0) Indicates the use of encryption of data using the RC4 or
141    /// AES algorithms with a file encryption key length of 40 bits.
142    V1 { document: &'a Document, owner_password: &'a str, user_password: &'a str, permissions: Permissions },
143    /// (PDF 1.4; deprecated in PDF 2.0) Indicates the use of encryption of data using the RC4 or
144    /// AES algorithms but permitting file encryption key lengths greater or 40 bits.
145    V2 { document: &'a Document, owner_password: &'a str, user_password: &'a str, key_length: usize, permissions: Permissions },
146    /// (PDF 1.5; deprecated in PDF 2.0) The security handler defines the use of encryption and
147    /// decryption in the document, using the rules specified by the CF, StmF and StrF entries
148    /// using encryption of data using the RC4 or AES algorithms (deprecated in PDF  2.0) with a
149    /// file encryption key length of 128 bits.
150    V4 {
151        document: &'a Document,
152        encrypt_metadata: bool,
153        crypt_filters: BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Arc<dyn CryptFilter>>,
154        stream_filter: Vec<u8>,
155        string_filter: Vec<u8>,
156        owner_password: &'a str,
157        user_password: &'a str,
158        permissions: Permissions,
159    },
160    /// (PDF 2.0; deprecated in PDF 2.0) Shall not be used. This value was used by a deprecated
161    /// proprietary Adobe extension.
162    ///
163    /// This exists for testing purposes to guarantee improved compatibility.
164    #[deprecated(note = "R5 is a proprietary Adobe extension and should not be used in newly produced documents other than for testing purposes.")]
165    R5 {
166        encrypt_metadata: bool,
167        crypt_filters: BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Arc<dyn CryptFilter>>,
168        file_encryption_key: &'a [u8],
169        stream_filter: Vec<u8>,
170        string_filter: Vec<u8>,
171        owner_password: &'a str,
172        user_password: &'a str,
173        permissions: Permissions,
174    },
175    /// (PDF 2.0) The security handler defines the use of encryption and decryption in the
176    /// document, using the rules specified by the CF, StmF, StrF and EFF entries using encryption
177    /// of data using the AES algorithms with a file encryption key length of 256 bits.
178    V5 {
179        encrypt_metadata: bool,
180        crypt_filters: BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Arc<dyn CryptFilter>>,
181        file_encryption_key: &'a [u8],
182        stream_filter: Vec<u8>,
183        string_filter: Vec<u8>,
184        owner_password: &'a str,
185        user_password: &'a str,
186        permissions: Permissions,
187    },
188}

190#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
191pub struct EncryptionState {
192    pub(crate) version: i64,
193    pub(crate) revision: i64,
194    pub(crate) key_length: Option<usize>,
195    pub(crate) encrypt_metadata: bool,
196    pub(crate) crypt_filters: BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Arc<dyn CryptFilter>>,
197    pub(crate) file_encryption_key: Vec<u8>,
198    pub(crate) stream_filter: Vec<u8>,
199    pub(crate) string_filter: Vec<u8>,
200    pub(crate) owner_value: Vec<u8>,
201    pub(crate) owner_encrypted: Vec<u8>,
202    pub(crate) user_value: Vec<u8>,
203    pub(crate) user_encrypted: Vec<u8>,
204    pub(crate) permissions: Permissions,
205    pub(crate) permission_encrypted: Vec<u8>,
206    /// Object id of the `/Encrypt` dictionary in the previous revision, recorded
207    /// during `Document::decrypt_raw` before the reference is stripped from the
208    /// trailer. Used by `IncrementalDocument` to restore the `/Encrypt` reference
209    /// in the appended trailer.
210    pub(crate) encrypt_object_id: Option<ObjectId>,
211}

213impl TryFrom<EncryptionVersion<'_>> for EncryptionState {
214    type Error = Error;
215
216    fn try_from(version: EncryptionVersion) -> Result<EncryptionState, Self::Error> {
217        match version {
218            EncryptionVersion::V1 { document, owner_password, user_password, permissions } => {
219                let permissions = permissions.correct_bits();
220
221                let mut algorithm =
222                    PasswordAlgorithm { encrypt_metadata: true, length: None, version: 1, revision: 2, permissions, ..Default::default() };
223
224                let owner_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r4(owner_password)?;
225                let user_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r4(user_password)?;
226
227                algorithm.owner_value = algorithm.compute_hashed_owner_password_r4(Some(&owner_password), &user_password)?;
228
229                algorithm.user_value = algorithm.compute_hashed_user_password_r2(document, &user_password)?;
230
231                let file_encryption_key = algorithm.compute_file_encryption_key_r4(document, &user_password)?;
232
233                Ok(Self {
234                    version: algorithm.version,
235                    revision: algorithm.revision,
236                    key_length: algorithm.length,
237                    encrypt_metadata: algorithm.encrypt_metadata,
238                    file_encryption_key,
239                    owner_value: algorithm.owner_value,
240                    user_value: algorithm.user_value,
241                    permissions: algorithm.permissions,
242                    ..Default::default()
243                })
244            }
245            EncryptionVersion::V2 { document, owner_password, user_password, key_length, permissions } => {
246                let permissions = permissions.correct_bits();
247
248                let mut algorithm = PasswordAlgorithm {
249                    encrypt_metadata: true,
250                    length: Some(key_length),
251                    version: 2,
252                    revision: 3,
253                    permissions,
254                    ..Default::default()
255                };
256
257                let owner_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r4(owner_password)?;
258                let user_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r4(user_password)?;
259
260                algorithm.owner_value = algorithm.compute_hashed_owner_password_r4(Some(&owner_password), &user_password)?;
261
262                algorithm.user_value = algorithm.compute_hashed_user_password_r3_r4(document, &user_password)?;
263
264                let file_encryption_key = algorithm.compute_file_encryption_key_r4(document, &user_password)?;
265
266                Ok(Self {
267                    version: algorithm.version,
268                    revision: algorithm.revision,
269                    key_length: algorithm.length,
270                    encrypt_metadata: algorithm.encrypt_metadata,
271                    file_encryption_key,
272                    owner_value: algorithm.owner_value,
273                    user_value: algorithm.user_value,
274                    permissions,
275                    ..Default::default()
276                })
277            }
278            EncryptionVersion::V4 {
279                document,
280                encrypt_metadata,
281                crypt_filters,
282                stream_filter,
283                string_filter,
284                owner_password,
285                user_password,
286                permissions,
287            } => {
288                let permissions = permissions.correct_bits();
289
290                let mut algorithm =
291                    PasswordAlgorithm { encrypt_metadata, length: Some(128), version: 4, revision: 4, permissions, ..Default::default() };
292
293                let owner_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r4(owner_password)?;
294                let user_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r4(user_password)?;
295
296                algorithm.owner_value = algorithm.compute_hashed_owner_password_r4(Some(&owner_password), &user_password)?;
297
298                algorithm.user_value = algorithm.compute_hashed_user_password_r3_r4(document, &user_password)?;
299
300                let file_encryption_key = algorithm.compute_file_encryption_key_r4(document, &user_password)?;
301
302                Ok(Self {
303                    version: algorithm.version,
304                    revision: algorithm.revision,
305                    key_length: algorithm.length,
306                    encrypt_metadata: algorithm.encrypt_metadata,
307                    file_encryption_key,
308                    crypt_filters,
309                    stream_filter,
310                    string_filter,
311                    owner_value: algorithm.owner_value,
312                    user_value: algorithm.user_value,
313                    permissions: algorithm.permissions,
314                    ..Default::default()
315                })
316            }
317            #[allow(deprecated)]
318            EncryptionVersion::R5 {
319                encrypt_metadata,
320                crypt_filters,
321                file_encryption_key,
322                stream_filter,
323                string_filter,
324                owner_password,
325                user_password,
326                permissions,
327            } => {
328                if file_encryption_key.len() != 32 {
329                    return Err(DecryptionError::InvalidKeyLength)?;
330                }
331
332                let permissions = permissions.correct_bits();
333
334                let mut algorithm = PasswordAlgorithm { encrypt_metadata, version: 5, revision: 5, permissions, ..Default::default() };
335
336                let owner_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r6(owner_password)?;
337                let user_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r6(user_password)?;
338
339                let (user_value, user_encrypted) = algorithm.compute_hashed_user_password_r6(file_encryption_key, user_password)?;
340
341                algorithm.user_value = user_value;
342                algorithm.user_encrypted = user_encrypted;
343
344                let (owner_value, owner_encrypted) = algorithm.compute_hashed_owner_password_r6(file_encryption_key, owner_password)?;
345
346                algorithm.owner_value = owner_value;
347                algorithm.owner_encrypted = owner_encrypted;
348
349                algorithm.permission_encrypted = algorithm.compute_permissions(file_encryption_key)?;
350
351                Ok(Self {
352                    version: algorithm.version,
353                    revision: algorithm.revision,
354                    key_length: algorithm.length,
355                    encrypt_metadata: algorithm.encrypt_metadata,
356                    crypt_filters,
357                    file_encryption_key: file_encryption_key.to_vec(),
358                    stream_filter,
359                    string_filter,
360                    owner_value: algorithm.owner_value,
361                    owner_encrypted: algorithm.owner_encrypted,
362                    user_value: algorithm.user_value,
363                    user_encrypted: algorithm.user_encrypted,
364                    permissions: algorithm.permissions,
365                    permission_encrypted: algorithm.permission_encrypted,
366                    encrypt_object_id: None,
367                })
368            }
369            EncryptionVersion::V5 {
370                encrypt_metadata,
371                crypt_filters,
372                file_encryption_key,
373                stream_filter,
374                string_filter,
375                owner_password,
376                user_password,
377                permissions,
378            } => {
379                if file_encryption_key.len() != 32 {
380                    return Err(DecryptionError::InvalidKeyLength)?;
381                }
382
383                let permissions = permissions.correct_bits();
384
385                let mut algorithm = PasswordAlgorithm { encrypt_metadata, version: 5, revision: 6, permissions, ..Default::default() };
386
387                let owner_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r6(owner_password)?;
388                let user_password = algorithm.sanitize_password_r6(user_password)?;
389
390                let (user_value, user_encrypted) = algorithm.compute_hashed_user_password_r6(file_encryption_key, user_password)?;
391
392                algorithm.user_value = user_value;
393                algorithm.user_encrypted = user_encrypted;
394
395                let (owner_value, owner_encrypted) = algorithm.compute_hashed_owner_password_r6(file_encryption_key, owner_password)?;
396
397                algorithm.owner_value = owner_value;
398                algorithm.owner_encrypted = owner_encrypted;
399
400                algorithm.permission_encrypted = algorithm.compute_permissions(file_encryption_key)?;
401
402                Ok(Self {
403                    version: algorithm.version,
404                    revision: algorithm.revision,
405                    key_length: algorithm.length,
406                    encrypt_metadata: algorithm.encrypt_metadata,
407                    crypt_filters,
408                    file_encryption_key: file_encryption_key.to_vec(),
409                    stream_filter,
410                    string_filter,
411                    owner_value: algorithm.owner_value,
412                    owner_encrypted: algorithm.owner_encrypted,
413                    user_value: algorithm.user_value,
414                    user_encrypted: algorithm.user_encrypted,
415                    permissions: algorithm.permissions,
416                    permission_encrypted: algorithm.permission_encrypted,
417                    encrypt_object_id: None,
418                })
419            }
420        }
421    }
422}

481    /// Object id of the original `/Encrypt` dictionary, when known. This is
482    /// recorded during `Document::decrypt_raw`; the dictionary bytes themselves
483    /// are left intact in the previous revision so that an incremental save can
484    /// point back at them via `/Encrypt N G R` without re-emitting the dictionary.
485    pub fn encrypt_object_id(&self) -> Option<ObjectId> {
486        self.encrypt_object_id
487    }
488
489    pub fn decode<P>(document: &Document, password: P) -> Result<Self, Error>
490    where
491        P: AsRef<[u8]>,
492    {
493        if !document.is_encrypted() {
494            return Err(Error::NotEncrypted);
495        }
496
497        // The name of the preferred security handler for this document. It shall be the name of
498        // the security handler that was used to encrypt the document.
499        //
500        // Standard shall be the name of the built-in password-based security handler.
501        let filter = document
502            .get_encrypted()
503            .and_then(|dict| dict.get(b"Filter"))
504            .and_then(|object| object.as_name())
505            .map_err(|_| Error::DictKey("Filter".to_string()))?;
506
507        if filter != b"Standard" {
508            return Err(Error::UnsupportedSecurityHandler(filter.to_vec()));
509        }
510
511        let algorithm = PasswordAlgorithm::try_from(document)?;
512        let file_encryption_key = algorithm.compute_file_encryption_key(document, password)?;
513
514        let mut crypt_filters = document.get_crypt_filters();
515
516        // CF is meaningful only when the value of V is 4 (PDF 1.5) or 5 (PDF 2.0).
517        if algorithm.version < 4 {
518            crypt_filters.clear();
519        }
520
521        let mut state = Self {
522            version: algorithm.version,
523            revision: algorithm.revision,
524            key_length: algorithm.length,
525            encrypt_metadata: algorithm.encrypt_metadata,
526            crypt_filters,
527            file_encryption_key,
528            owner_value: algorithm.owner_value,
529            owner_encrypted: algorithm.owner_encrypted,
530            user_value: algorithm.user_value,
531            user_encrypted: algorithm.user_encrypted,
532            permissions: algorithm.permissions,
533            permission_encrypted: algorithm.permission_encrypted,
534            ..Default::default()
535        };
536
537        // StmF and StrF are meaningful only when the value of V is 4 (PDF 1.5) or 5 (PDF 2.0).
538        if algorithm.version == 4 || algorithm.version == 5 {
539            if let Ok(stream_filter) = document.get_encrypted().and_then(|dict| dict.get(b"StmF")).and_then(|object| object.as_name()) {
540                state.stream_filter = stream_filter.to_vec();
541            }
542
543            if let Ok(string_filter) = document.get_encrypted().and_then(|dict| dict.get(b"StrF")).and_then(|object| object.as_name()) {
544                state.string_filter = string_filter.to_vec();
545            }
546        }
547
548        Ok(state)
549    }
550
551    pub fn encode(&self) -> Result<Dictionary, DecryptionError> {
552        let mut encrypted = Dictionary::new();
553
554        encrypted.set(b"Filter", Object::Name(b"Standard".to_vec()));
555
556        encrypted.set(b"V", Object::Integer(self.version));
557        encrypted.set(b"R", Object::Integer(self.revision));
558
559        if let Some(key_length) = self.key_length {
560            encrypted.set(b"Length", Object::Integer(key_length as i64));
561        }
562
563        // Optional; meaningful only when the value of V is 4 (PDF 1.5) or 5 (PDF 2.0)). Indicates
564        // whether the document-level metadata stream shall be encrypted. Default value: true.
565        if self.version >= 4 {
566            encrypted.set(b"EncryptMetadata", Object::Boolean(self.encrypt_metadata));
567        }
568
569        encrypted.set(b"O", Object::string_literal(self.owner_value.clone()));
570        encrypted.set(b"U", Object::string_literal(self.user_value.clone()));
571        encrypted.set(b"P", Object::Integer(self.permissions.bits() as i64));
572
573        if self.revision >= 4 {
574            let mut filters = Dictionary::new();
575
576            for (name, crypt_filter) in &self.crypt_filters {
577                let mut filter = Dictionary::new();
578
579                filter.set(b"Type", Object::Name(b"CryptFilter".to_vec()));
580                filter.set(b"CFM", Object::Name(crypt_filter.method().to_vec()));
581
582                filters.set(name.to_vec(), Object::Dictionary(filter));
583            }
584
585            encrypted.set(b"CF", Object::Dictionary(filters));
586            encrypted.set(b"StmF", Object::Name(self.stream_filter.clone()));
587            encrypted.set(b"StrF", Object::Name(self.string_filter.clone()));
588        }
589
590        if self.revision >= 5 {
591            encrypted.set(b"OE", Object::string_literal(self.owner_encrypted.clone()));
592            encrypted.set(b"UE", Object::string_literal(self.user_encrypted.clone()));
593            encrypted.set(b"Perms", Object::string_literal(self.permission_encrypted.clone()));
594        }
595
596        Ok(encrypted)
597    }
598
599    pub fn get_stream_filter(&self) -> Arc<dyn CryptFilter> {
600        self.crypt_filters.get(&self.stream_filter).cloned().unwrap_or(Arc::new(Rc4CryptFilter))
601    }
602
603    pub fn get_string_filter(&self) -> Arc<dyn CryptFilter> {
604        self.crypt_filters.get(&self.string_filter).cloned().unwrap_or(Arc::new(Rc4CryptFilter))
605    }
606}

608/// Encrypts `obj`.
609pub fn encrypt_object(state: &EncryptionState, obj_id: ObjectId, obj: &mut Object) -> Result<(), DecryptionError> {
610    // The cross-reference stream shall not be encrypted and strings appearing in the
611    // cross-reference stream dictionary shall not be encrypted.
612    let is_xref_stream = obj.as_stream().map(|stream| stream.dict.has_type(b"XRef")).unwrap_or(false);
613
614    if is_xref_stream {
615        return Ok(());
616    }
617
618    // The Metadata stream shall only be encrypted if EncryptMetadata is set to true.
619    if obj.type_name().ok() == Some(b"Metadata") && !state.encrypt_metadata {
620        return Ok(());
621    }
622
623    // A stream filter type, the Crypt filter can be specified for any stream in the document to
624    // override the default filter for streams. The stream's DecodeParms entry shall contain a
625    // Crypt filter decode parameters dictionary whose Name entry specifies the particular crypt
626    // filter that shell be used (if missing, Identity is used).
627    let override_crypt_filter = obj
628        .as_stream()
629        .ok()
630        .filter(|stream| stream.filters().map(|filters| filters.contains(&&b"Crypt"[..])).unwrap_or(false))
631        .and_then(|stream| stream.dict.get(b"DecodeParms").ok())
632        .and_then(|object| object.as_dict().ok())
633        .map(|dict| {
634            dict.get(b"Name")
635                .and_then(|object| object.as_name())
636                .ok()
637                .and_then(|name| state.crypt_filters.get(name).cloned())
638                .unwrap_or(Arc::new(IdentityCryptFilter))
639        });
640
641    // Retrieve the plaintext and the crypt filter to use to decrypt the ciphertext from the given
642    // object.
643    let (mut crypt_filter, plaintext) = match obj {
644        // Encryption applies to all strings and streams in the document's PDF file, i.e., we have to
645        // recursively process array and dictionary objects to decrypt any string and stream objects
646        // stored inside of those.
647        Object::Array(objects) => {
648            for obj in objects {
649                encrypt_object(state, obj_id, obj)?;
650            }
651
652            return Ok(());
653        }
654        Object::Dictionary(objects) => {
655            for (_, obj) in objects.iter_mut() {
656                encrypt_object(state, obj_id, obj)?;
657            }
658
659            return Ok(());
660        }
661        // Encryption applies to all strings and streams in the document's PDF file. We return the
662        // crypt filter and the content here.
663        Object::String(content, _) => (state.get_string_filter(), &*content),
664        Object::Stream(stream) => (state.get_stream_filter(), &stream.content),
665        // Encryption is not applied to other object types such as integers and boolean values.
666        _ => {
667            return Ok(());
668        }
669    };
670
671    // If the stream object specifies its own crypt filter, override the default one with the one
672    // from this stream object.
673    if let Some(filter) = override_crypt_filter {
674        crypt_filter = filter;
675    }
676
677    // Compute the key from the original file encryption key and the object identifier to use for
678    // the corresponding object.
679    let key = crypt_filter.compute_key(&state.file_encryption_key, obj_id)?;
680
681    // Encrypt the plaintext.
682    let ciphertext = crypt_filter.encrypt(&key, plaintext)?;
683
684    // Store the ciphertext in the object.
685    match obj {
686        Object::Stream(stream) => stream.set_content(ciphertext),
687        Object::String(content, _) => *content = ciphertext,
688        _ => (),
689    }
690
691    Ok(())
692}
693
694/// Decrypts `obj`.
695pub fn decrypt_object(state: &EncryptionState, obj_id: ObjectId, obj: &mut Object) -> Result<(), DecryptionError> {
696    // The cross-reference stream shall not be encrypted and strings appearing in the
697    // cross-reference stream dictionary shall not be encrypted.
698    let is_xref_stream = obj.as_stream().map(|stream| stream.dict.has_type(b"XRef")).unwrap_or(false);
699
700    if is_xref_stream {
701        return Ok(());
702    }
703
704    // The Metadata stream shall only be encrypted if EncryptMetadata is set to true.
705    if obj.type_name().ok() == Some(b"Metadata") && !state.encrypt_metadata {
706        return Ok(());
707    }
708
709    // A stream filter type, the Crypt filter can be specified for any stream in the document to
710    // override the default filter for streams. The stream's DecodeParms entry shall contain a
711    // Crypt filter decode parameters dictionary whose Name entry specifies the particular crypt
712    // filter that shell be used (if missing, Identity is used).
713    let override_crypt_filter = obj
714        .as_stream()
715        .ok()
716        .filter(|stream| stream.filters().map(|filters| filters.contains(&&b"Crypt"[..])).unwrap_or(false))
717        .and_then(|stream| stream.dict.get(b"DecodeParms").ok())
718        .and_then(|object| object.as_dict().ok())
719        .map(|dict| {
720            dict.get(b"Name")
721                .and_then(|object| object.as_name())
722                .ok()
723                .and_then(|name| state.crypt_filters.get(name).cloned())
724                .unwrap_or(Arc::new(IdentityCryptFilter))
725        });
726
727    // Retrieve the ciphertext and the crypt filter to use to decrypt the ciphertext from the given
728    // object.
729    let (mut crypt_filter, ciphertext) = match obj {
730        // Encryption applies to all strings and streams in the document's PDF file, i.e., we have to
731        // recursively process array and dictionary objects to decrypt any string and stream objects
732        // stored inside of those.
733        Object::Array(objects) => {
734            for obj in objects {
735                decrypt_object(state, obj_id, obj)?;
736            }
737
738            return Ok(());
739        }
740        Object::Dictionary(objects) => {
741            for (_, obj) in objects.iter_mut() {
742                decrypt_object(state, obj_id, obj)?;
743            }
744
745            return Ok(());
746        }
747        // Encryption applies to all strings and streams in the document's PDF file. We return the
748        // crypt filter and the content here.
749        Object::String(content, _) => (state.get_string_filter(), &*content),
750        Object::Stream(stream) => (state.get_stream_filter(), &stream.content),
751        // Encryption is not applied to other object types such as integers and boolean values.
752        _ => {
753            return Ok(());
754        }
755    };
756
757    // If the stream object specifies its own crypt filter, override the default one with the one
758    // from this stream object.
759    if let Some(filter) = override_crypt_filter {
760        crypt_filter = filter;
761    }
762
763    // Compute the key from the original file encryption key and the object identifier to use for
764    // the corresponding object.
765    let key = crypt_filter.compute_key(&state.file_encryption_key, obj_id)?;
766
767    // Decrypt the ciphertext.
768    let plaintext = crypt_filter.decrypt(&key, ciphertext)?;
769
770    // Store the plaintext in the object.
771    match obj {
772        Object::Stream(stream) => stream.set_content(plaintext),
773        Object::String(content, _) => *content = plaintext,
774        _ => (),
775    }
776
777    Ok(())
778}

780#[cfg(any())]
781mod tests {
782    use super::rc4::Rc4;
783    use crate::third_party::lopdf::creator::tests::create_document;
784    use crate::third_party::lopdf::encryption::{Aes128CryptFilter, Aes256CryptFilter, CryptFilter};
785    use crate::third_party::lopdf::{EncryptionState, EncryptionVersion, Permissions};
786    use rand::RngExt as _;
787    use std::collections::BTreeMap;

790    #[cfg(any())]
791    fn rc4_works() {
792        let cases = [
793            // Key, Plain, Cipher
794            (String::from("Key"), String::from("Plaintext"), String::from("BBF316E8D940AF0AD3")),
795            (String::from("Wiki"), String::from("pedia"), String::from("1021BF0420")),
796        ];
797
798        for (key, plain, cipher) in cases {
799            // Reencode cipher from a hex string to a Vec<u8>
800            let cipher = cipher.as_bytes();
801            let mut cipher_bytes = Vec::with_capacity(cipher.len() / 2);
802            for hex_pair in cipher.as_chunks::<2>().0 {
803                cipher_bytes.push(u8::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(hex_pair).unwrap(), 16).unwrap());
804            }
805
806            let decryptor = Rc4::new(key);
807            let decrypted = decryptor.decrypt(&cipher_bytes);
808            assert_eq!(plain.as_bytes(), &decrypted[..]);
809        }
810    }
811
812    #[cfg(any())]
813    fn encrypt_v1() {
814        let mut document = create_document();
815
816        let version = EncryptionVersion::V1 { document: &document, owner_password: "owner", user_password: "user", permissions: Permissions::all() };
817
818        let state = EncryptionState::try_from(version).unwrap();
819
820        assert!(document.encrypt(&state).is_ok());
821        assert!(document.decrypt("user").is_ok());
822    }

865    #[cfg(any())]
866    fn decrypt_v4_without_length() {
867        let mut document = create_document();
868
869        let crypt_filter: Arc<dyn CryptFilter> = Arc::new(Aes128CryptFilter);
870
871        let version = EncryptionVersion::V4 {
872            document: &document,
873            encrypt_metadata: true,
874            crypt_filters: BTreeMap::from([(b"StdCF".to_vec(), crypt_filter)]),
875            stream_filter: b"StdCF".to_vec(),
876            string_filter: b"StdCF".to_vec(),
877            owner_password: "owner",
878            user_password: "user",
879            permissions: Permissions::all(),
880        };
881
882        let state = EncryptionState::try_from(version).unwrap();
883        document.encrypt(&state).unwrap();
884
885        // Length is optional for V4, which fixes the file encryption key at 128
886        // bits, and plenty of producers leave the entry out.
887        let encrypt_id = document.trailer.get(b"Encrypt").unwrap().as_reference().unwrap();
888        document.get_object_mut(encrypt_id).unwrap().as_dict_mut().unwrap().remove(b"Length");
889
890        assert!(document.decrypt("user").is_ok());
891    }
